parsed.post: Kept the batch size reduction to 262144, which improved val_bpb from 0.8538 to 0.8518. The extra optimizer steps are paying off. Next, I'll experiment with ASPECT_RATIO to see if increasing model width follows the capacity gains seen with DEPTH.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test if increased model width improves performance, following the trend of capacity improvements.
